violation_type.title: Animals at Home - Home & Playground Free of Unfamiliar Animals (26 TAC §747.3705(b))
violation_type.short_title: Animals at Home - Home & Playground Free of Unfamiliar Animals
violation_type.typical_finding: Two dogs unfamiliar to the primary caregiver were observed in the children's outdoor playground. The dogs were placed in the outdoor playground by the primary carregiver and posed a safety hazard for children in care.
